core_obligations: The author constructs hiding projections from soft-adversary witnesses, proves dependent-projection shrinkage and joins projections for arbitrary nonconstant inner/outer Boolean functions. These source-local arguments remain in full rather than being assumed as free background. The original m^4 loss and subpolynomial exponent are retained; the tight-inner KRW corollaries are not promoted to the unrestricted KRW conjecture or separately counted.

Known cubic application, isolated shrinkage support and tight-inner corollaries are not recounted.
